features.quote: Hard cap at 15 turns (Action/Observation cycles) or 32,000 elapsed tokens, whichever comes first.

Be highly precise in internal/external communications that you are measuring *anthropomorphic behavioral emulation* and *policy robustness*, not actual suffering, to avoid AI safety/sentience PR nightmares or philosophical muddying of technical metrics.
